controls: Same historical input and plain binary SHA, single thread, 21600-second limit, 500-GiB virtual memory, unchanged Latin-rotation order/seed from the previous nine-attempt ablation. Every run exports full core CSV and compares its SHA to historical references.
environment_improvements: Preflight chooses fixed NUMA0 core26/90 with lower maximum observed activity; taskset CPU26, numactl --membind=0; observer/helper CPU63; 120-second stable prelaunch gate rather than 15 seconds; stricter prelaunch node/pressure gates. Runtime numerical caps retain v2 thresholds on the selected CPU pair.
limits_of_control: CPU/NUMA affinity is not system-level exclusivity. Background tasks can still compete for CPU, caches, bandwidth and I/O; preserve all quality flags. No privileged configuration, root filesystem writes, extra algorithm warmups or changes to other projects.
analysis: All three repeats contribute to a successful configuration mean. Require all three correct and load-clean to call a controlled within-cohort comparison. No mixing old/new repeats or selecting successful/fast runs. Retain old 405 and 141 records. No automatic extra runs.
